lines.text: Amnon, David's son, loves Tamar, Absalom's sister, and tells his friend Jonadab, the son of Shimeah.
Amnon pretends to be ill and asks the king to send Tamar to make cakes in his sight.
Amnon sends everyone away, takes hold of Tamar in the courtyard, and tells her to lie with him.
Amnon hates Tamar and tells his attendant to throw her out and bolt the door.
Tamar lives in Amnon's house, and David is furious, while Absalom never speaks to Amnon.

wrong_details.true: the house of her brother Absalom
